failure_surface: allocation_delta
predicate: CVaR tail objective can make allocation delta CI strictly below zero on the exported PushT latent ledger.

failure_surface: independent PushT export replication
predicate: A separately exported PushT checkpoint should reproduce the UER separation direction without relying on prior cached verdicts.

failure_surface: multi-horizon ledger vector input
predicate: Multi-horizon gap-ledger vector reader separates failure surfaces MORE reliably than a single-horizon scalar: paired AUROC gain (vector - scalar) CI strictly above zero, with no label-defining variable inside the features.

failure_surface: cross-environment zero-shot reader transfer
predicate: A gap-reader trained on tworooms latents separates failure above AUROC 0.5 when evaluated zero-shot on reacher latents.

failure_surface: split-conformal selective risk on held-out eval
predicate: The split-conformal selective rule (the Lean-verified counting core) keeps realized failure-among-admitted risk strictly below the target alpha on held-out eval: risk_margin = alpha - realized_risk, CI strictly above 0.

failure_surface: reader capacity vs information ceiling
predicate: An MLP gap-reader separates failure more than a linear reader (paired AUROC gain CI above 0); if not, capacity is saturated and the rho~0.5 ceiling is informational not capacity-bound.

failure_surface: BEDC-native next-latent predictor recipe (derisk for GPU-scale)
predicate: A small BEDC-native next-latent predictor trained on fixed tworooms latents beats a trivial persistence baseline (native_mse - trivial_mse CI strictly below 0 = learned real dynamics); reported_claim also records native/LeWM predictor MSE ratio and whether a larger predictor narrows the gap (scaling signal).

failure_surface: BEDC gap-ledger objective vs plain next-latent objective (recipe rethink per fi-007)
predicate: Adding the BEDC gap-ledger loss term to the native next-latent objective lowers eval next-latent MSE vs the plain objective (ledger_mse - plain_mse CI strictly below 0); tests whether the BEDC objective, not just model size, narrows the LeWM gap (fi-007 showed naive scaling barely helps).

failure_surface: few-shot cross-env reader transfer (boundary probe per fi-004)
predicate: Fine-tuning the gap-reader on a few reacher episodes lifts target-env failure AUROC above null 0.5 where zero-shot (fi-004) failed; tests whether the env-specificity boundary is crossable with minimal target data.

failure_surface: failure-type discrimination beyond binary fail/no-fail
predicate: The gap-ledger reader discriminates failure TYPES (perturbation families) above chance: one-vs-rest macro AUROC CI above null 0.5; tests whether the ledger carries failure-mode structure, not just a failure scalar. No label-defining variable in features.

failure_surface: architecture-level ledger conditioning vs loss-term-only (deepen fi-008 lead)
predicate: A next-latent predictor whose architecture conditions on the gap-ledger state lowers eval MSE vs a plain predictor by more than fi-008's loss-term-only ledger objective (conditioned_minus_plain_mse CI below 0, gain magnitude reported vs fi-008's -0.060); tests whether deeper ledger integration is the lever that scale (fi-007) is not.

failure_surface: capacity-matched ledger-conditioned architecture controls
predicate: A capacity-matched next-latent predictor whose FiLM conditioning receives the learned ledger signal lowers eval MSE versus an otherwise identical constant-ledger FiLM arm, while reporting plain and shuffled-ledger controls. This hardens the ledger-conditioned architecture test by separating signal conditioning from extra parameters and optimization artifacts.

failure_surface: allocation-useful ranking (the binding BEDC-native bottleneck)
predicate: A BEDC-native ledger that ingests rollout-internal features (predicted rollout trajectory zhat_{t+1:t+h}, prediction deltas, multi-horizon ledger vector) and is trained with a CVaR/tail-rank allocation objective achieves allocation_delta vs uniform with CI strictly below zero, breaking the rho~0.5 readable-information ceiling that single-point score-sorting and fi-001's within-design CVaR could not; reports paired native-vs-posthoc detection dAUROC and selective risk for completeness.

failure_surface: representation-side allocation (P4: shape latent, not readout)
predicate: Training a re-encoder with a CVaR/tail-allocation representation objective produces a latent whose allocation_delta vs uniform has CI strictly below zero, breaking the rho~0.5 fixed-latent ceiling that readout-side levers (fi-001 CVaR, fi-012 rollout-features+CVaR) could not.

failure_surface: from-scratch native encoder allocation (post-hoc exhausted -> train the encoder)
predicate: A small BEDC-native encoder trained from scratch on tworooms pixels with a tail-allocation objective baked into its latent produces a latent whose allocation_delta vs uniform has CI strictly below zero, breaking the rho~0.5 ceiling that NO post-hoc transform of the fixed LeWM latent (readout fi-001/fi-012, re-encoder fi-013) could break; tests whether allocation requires training the encoder itself.

failure_surface: from-scratch encoder allocation with verified non-collapsed latent (decisive 8GB attempt)
predicate: With a verified non-collapsed latent (VICReg variance/covariance regularization, sufficient epochs), a from-scratch native encoder on tworooms pixels yields allocation_delta CI below zero; if it still fails with a healthy latent, allocation is decisively bounded at the 8GB scale and requires GPU-scale.

failure_surface: selective-prediction tier (8GB-feasible; detection won, allocation GPU-blocked)
predicate: Using the winning native horizon-ledger score with a conservative split-conformal calibration, the selective rule robustly holds realized failure-among-admitted risk strictly below alpha=0.10 with usable coverage on held-out eval (risk_margin = alpha - realized_risk, CI strictly above 0), upgrading fi-005's marginal result to a solid selective-success tier.

failure_surface: harden the detection win: native vs the STRONGEST post-hoc (not a weak MLP)
predicate: The native horizon-indexed ledger still beats the STRONGEST post-hoc probe (the campaign logistic gap head, ~0.731, which previously beat the early native 0.675) in paired episode-bootstrap comparison: native - strongest_posthoc AUROC CI strictly above zero. This addresses the fi-012 caveat that the +0.099 was against a weak current_z MLP, making the detection breakthrough defensible.

failure_surface: G2N integrated A100 direct paired detection against strongest Phase1c post-hoc
predicate: The full integrated G2N A100 row beats the strongest Phase1c logistic post-hoc probe in a direct per-anchor episode-bootstrap comparison, not merely by scalar hardening against a historical strongest-probe value.

failure_surface: G2N integrated A100 selective admission calibration
predicate: Without retraining the integrated G2N A100 row, a calibration-only admission sweep finds an operating point whose realized eval failure-among-admitted risk is at or below alpha with usable coverage.

failure_surface: G2N integrated A100 shuffled-label capacity-artifact guard
predicate: The full integrated G2N A100 configuration collapses under within-episode shuffled horizon labels, giving finite h1 AUROC below 0.60 and ruling out a simple capacity artifact for the accepted detection row.

failure_surface: option-conditioned marginal compute value for BEDC-native planning
predicate: A BEDC-native model trained on direct marginal compute-value labels MV(t,b), where b indexes rollout depth, refinement, or abstention options, predicts option-level intervention value well enough to make allocation_delta versus uniform strictly negative while separately preserving detection AUROC and selective-risk gates.

failure_surface: option-conditioned exact-budget compute-value assignment
predicate: A BEDC-native option-conditioned model that predicts option error from rollout-internal state and candidate depth, then applies an exact per-episode budget dynamic program, achieves allocation_delta versus uniform with CI strictly below zero on held-out evaluation anchors.

failure_surface: independent-export rollout-only option-conditioned compute-value assignment
predicate: A rollout-only BEDC-native option-conditioned model, trained on an independent PushT horizon export using predicted rollout trajectory features but no base latent/action features, predicts option error well enough for exact per-episode budget assignment to achieve allocation_delta versus uniform with CI strictly below zero. This is scoped to rollout-only independent export and is not a full-feature structured-assignment replication.

failure_surface: joint horizon detection and option-conditioned compute-value supervision
predicate: A shared-trunk BEDC-native model with both horizon-q75 failure logits and option-conditioned compute-error scores closes the exact-budget allocation gate versus uniform on the fixed export. This hypothesis tests whether detection supervision is sufficient to improve compute-value control.

failure_surface: independent-export full-feature option-conditioned compute-value assignment
predicate: A BEDC-native option-conditioned model trained on an independent export with aligned base latent/action state, predicted rollout-internal features, and direct option-error labels closes the exact-budget allocation gate versus uniform. The runner must fail closed when the independent export lacks aligned emb/action/pred carrier arrays, so rollout-only evidence is not treated as a full-feature replication.

failure_surface: BEDC-native world-model prediction parity hard gate
predicate: A BEDC-native world-state candidate is not promoted from monitor or diagnostic ledger to world model unless its next-latent prediction loss is within a declared tolerance of the LeWM predictor on the same target scale and evaluation transitions.

failure_surface: direct BEDC-native next-latent parity candidate
predicate: A directly trained BEDC-native next-latent candidate using a latent window, action window, historical gap proxy, and calibration-selected residual predictor reaches the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate while still being evaluated against trivial persistence and the LeWM predictor on identical eval transitions.

failure_surface: LeWM-transition-target native parity candidate
predicate: A native residual predictor trained against the LeWM next-latent transition target, but evaluated against true next-latent error on the same transitions, reaches the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. This tests whether the parity failure comes from the direct next-latent target rather than from the native input and architecture class.

failure_surface: sequence-native next-latent parity candidate
predicate: A sequence-native BEDC candidate that encodes latent history, future action-validity, historical gap proxy, and time features with recurrent dynamics reaches the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. This tests whether adding sequence inductive bias is enough to move the parity boundary beyond the flattened residual predictor.

failure_surface: action-conditioned multi-step dynamics parity candidate
predicate: A BEDC-native action-conditioned recurrent dynamics model trained with teacher-forced multi-step latent rollout losses reaches the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate on one-step next-latent MSE while also reporting multi-step rollout error. This tests whether prediction parity requires a dynamics objective rather than local readout or one-step residual training.

failure_surface: local scaling of action-conditioned multi-step dynamics
predicate: A wider and deeper local multi-step dynamics candidate improves the best h=5 multi-step row enough to reach the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. This tests whether the parity gap is already closing under local scaling before an A100-scale run is treated as the next required computation.

failure_surface: transition-level upper bound for action-conditioned multi-step dynamics
predicate: A transition-level train/calibration/eval split for the scaled h=5 multi-step dynamics candidate reaches the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. Because episodes may appear in multiple splits, this is an upper-bound diagnostic for fit and local generalization, not an episode-heldout world-model claim.

failure_surface: heldout-generalization and residual-fit decomposition for action-conditioned multi-step dynamics
predicate: The scaled h=5 action-conditioned multi-step dynamics row closes the prediction-parity gap once transition-level upper-bound fit is separated from episode-heldout generalization. The diagnostic is positive only if the residual transition-level parity gap is not above zero; otherwise it records that fit and heldout generalization remain separate bottlenecks.

failure_surface: one-step-focused loss for action-conditioned multi-step dynamics parity
predicate: A scaled h=5 action-conditioned dynamics model trained with loss only on the first rollout step improves native one-step MSE relative to the decay-weighted multi-step loss. This tests whether the parity gap is caused by later rollout losses competing with the one-step prediction gate.

failure_surface: uniform multi-step loss for action-conditioned dynamics parity
predicate: A scaled h=5 action-conditioned dynamics model trained with uniform loss across rollout steps improves native one-step MSE enough to reach the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. This tests whether the decay-weighted multi-step loss underuses later rollout supervision while preserving one-step accuracy.

failure_surface: A100 scaling of uniform-loss action-conditioned dynamics parity
predicate: The local uniform-loss h=5 action-conditioned dynamics recipe continues improving under A100 scaling enough to reach the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. The runner fails closed until the A100 report is present in the local reports directory.

failure_surface: A100 scaling of decay-loss action-conditioned dynamics parity
predicate: The decay-weighted h=5 action-conditioned dynamics recipe continues improving under A100 scaling enough to reach the LeWM prediction-parity world-model gate. The runner fails closed until the A100 report is present in the local reports directory.

failure_surface: matched-seed replication of uniform versus decay multi-step dynamics loss
predicate: A matched alternate seed reproduces the uniform-loss advantage over the decay-weighted multi-step dynamics objective. This checks whether the observed uniform-loss improvement is stable enough to treat as a stronger local recipe rather than a seed-specific fluctuation.

failure_surface: synthesis of local loss-profile evidence across seeds
predicate: The local uniform-loss advantage over the decay-weighted multi-step dynamics objective is stable across the main scaled row and a matched alternate-seed replication. This synthesis determines whether the A100 uniform-loss queue row should be interpreted as scaling a validated stronger local recipe or as an exploratory loss-profile row.

failure_surface: current prediction-parity boundary for BEDC-native dynamics rows
predicate: The current prediction-parity evidence establishes a bounded boundary: the best episode-heldout row, the transition-level upper-bound diagnostic, and the completed A100 uniform/decay dynamics rows all remain outside the LeWM parity gate. This synthesis separates completed negative prediction-parity evidence from the scoped compute/control findings.

failure_surface: compute-value distinction survival across independent carriers
predicate: A learned option-conditioned compute-value distinction survives option-error readout after base controls and closes exact-budget allocation on at least two independent carriers. This tests whether the BEDC-native world-state variable is a scoped compute/control distinction rather than a failure-probability head, while leaving non-universal carriers explicit.

failure_surface: survival/control distinction versus prediction-parity world-model boundary
predicate: The current BEDC-JEPA evidence separates a scoped compute/control distinction from a full BEDC-native world-model claim: compute-value survival closes on independent carriers, while the best completed prediction-parity margin remains negative after the A100 dynamics rows. This synthesis prevents compute-value success from being promoted into prediction parity or universal control.

failure_surface: A100 scaling-efficiency diagnostic for current dynamics route
predicate: The completed A100 multi-step dynamics rows provide a positive scaling-efficiency signal only if the A100 native h1 MSE improves over the matched local row. This gate tests whether the current dynamics route is still justified as a simple scale-up path rather than requiring a different BEDC state-generation objective.

failure_surface: BEDC-native state-generation contract after compute/control and parity boundary separation
predicate: A BEDC-native state-generation contract is required when scoped compute/control survival is closed, prediction parity remains negative, and completed A100 scale diagnostics do not provide a positive scale-up signal. This gate turns the next route into a tracked contract: train world-state generation under joint prediction-parity and compute/control-survival gates rather than relying on fixed-carrier heads or simple dynamics scaling.

failure_surface: aligned export readiness for BEDC-native state-generation training
predicate: Existing compute-value and multi-step dynamics artifacts are sufficient to train a BEDC-native state-generation candidate only if they share enough episode-heldout anchors and the compute-value distinction provides held-out survival for dynamics error after base controls. If this fails, the next experiment must generate an aligned export rather than stitching unrelated artifacts.

failure_surface: validated aligned export for BEDC-native state-generation training
predicate: A single aligned export is ready for BEDC-native state-generation training only if prediction targets, compute-value option labels, horizon labels, rollout features, and ledger variables are present on the same train/calibration/eval anchors with sufficient episode-heldout support. The export is a training substrate, not a trained world model.

failure_surface: first aligned BEDC-native state-generation candidate
predicate: A first aligned BEDC-native state-generation candidate is valid only if it trains on the aligned export, reports held-out next-latent prediction, compute-value option-error, and horizon-failure heads on the same eval anchors, and keeps prediction/control claims scoped to the measured gates. This validates a measured candidate, not prediction parity, allocation closure, or a complete BEDC-native world model.

failure_surface: state-generation candidate allocation boundary diagnostic
predicate: The aligned state-generation candidate allocation boundary is diagnosed only if the fixed candidate scores have global option-error rank signal, fail the exact-budget allocation gate, and the same eval labels admit a closed exact-budget oracle. This separates score readability from allocation-useful control and prevents rank correlation from being promoted into allocation closure.

failure_surface: allocation-native state-generation calibration-to-eval boundary
predicate: An allocation-native state-generation scorer is a closed policy only if calibration-selected exact-budget allocation transfers to held-out eval. If calibration closes but eval remains open while the eval oracle is closed, the result diagnoses a calibration-to-eval allocation gap rather than allocation success.
